questions.question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the mother of B',

'A-B' means 'A is the brother of B',

'Ax B' means 'A is the wife of B',

'A% B' means 'A is the father of B' and

'A # B' means 'A is the daughter of B'.

How is E related to P if 'E % C # Q # L+ P'?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74d0ce391ee26c9e1fbd76d603cc74b3853619c99ed8f7b23f50db35d7a97cde.png] 

**Given Code Language:**

 
 

 Symbol
 Meaning
 
 

 A + B
 A is the mother of B
 
 

 A - B
 A is the brother of B
 
 

 A x B
 A is the wife of B
 
 

 A % B
 A is the father of B
 
 

 A # B
 A is the daughter of B
 
 

 

**Expression:**

**E % C # Q # L + P:** E is father of C. C is daughter of Q. Q is daughter of L. L is mother of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/992d42a7661c52a43e645dd3f2f0e0d6931fb7978c98a0e5990dbfa46bfc07dc.png] 

Since Q is sister of P, E becomes **P’s sister’s husband**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4 — Sister's husband**.

questions.question:
Shivank starts from Point A and drives 15 km towards north. He then takes a left turn, drives 11 km, turns left and drives 16 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 14 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 1 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again?

(Note: All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Shivank starts from Point A and drives 15 km towards north.

He then takes a left turn, drives 11 km.

He turns left and drives 16 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 14 km.

 He takes a final left turn, drives 1 km and stops at Point P.

**Step-by-step movement:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/083cf3ca1ce0ad36a2cf46043e440a944fe71ba016790b78b4ab92d36e0b6204.png] 

**Net movement calculation:**

North-South:

15 km north + 1 km north − 16 km south = 0

So, no north/south displacement.

East-West:

14 km east − 11 km west = 3 km east

So Shivank is 3 km east of Point A.

To reach Point A again, he must travel **3 km to the west**.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All jams are cobras.

All cobras are mats.

**Conclusions:**

(I): Some mats are cobras.

(II): All jams are mats.
questions.solution:

Therefore, both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding to/subtracting from/multiplying with 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(9, 13, 26)

(7, 9, 22)
questions.solution:
Logic followed here is:

**2nd number: (1st number × 2) - 5

3rd number: (1st number × 2) + 8**

**For (9, 13, 26) →**

Second number = (9 × 2) - 5 = 13

Third number = (9 × 2) + 8 = 26

 

**For (7, 9, 22) →**

Second number = (7 × 2) - 5 = 9

Third number = (7 × 2) + 8 = 22

 

**Similarly, Option 2) (11, 17, 30):**

Second number = (11 × 2) - 5 = 17

Third number = (11 × 2) + 8 = 30

∴ The related set is (11, 17, 30).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question: In a row of 103 students facing north, Z is 15th from the right end. If G is 36th to the left of Z, what is G's position from the left end of the line?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total students = 103

Z is 15th from the right end.

**Step 1: Find Z's position from the left**

Position from left = Total students − Position from right + 1

= 103 − 15 + 1
